style: Say curiously and warmly, like a friendly school librarian
lines: Tap a pin on the map, or pick from the Station list, to open its climate chart.
Now press Place on chart to see where this place sits in climate space.
Answer each question with the Yes, No or number buttons. The numbers are on the card.
That's your prediction. Press Reveal to see what really grows there.
Your key matches the real biome.
A miss. Read the note under the cards to see what averages hide.
Key this station first. Press Go to Key.
Press Fire or Clearing, then press Play and watch the land grow back.
The key now predicts a different biome. Press Play to watch the new path.
Same climate, same biome. It came back.
Press Next station to investigate another climate, or Change to test recovery.
Read the comparison, then answer the next question with the Yes, No or number buttons.
Pick another Station, or press Key to predict this biome.
Watch the land recover. Drag Years after to pause and inspect a stage.
Drag Years after to rewind, or press Play to continue.
Move the climate sliders to compare paths, or press Reset climate.
Read the comparisons, then press Key again to retry, or Reveal to compare biomes.
Your answers took a different path. Press Check my answers to inspect the comparisons.
